failure_summary.description: Search or filter results were returned without being saved as new cache entries.
Concrete answers to domain-specific clarification questions were not applied to the pending request.
A qualitative atmosphere preference was incorrectly passed as a neighborhood.
The generated code imported a nonexistent tools module and failed at runtime.

patch.reasoning: The main uncovered gap is how to interpret concrete replies to assistant clarification questions, especially date intervals for a pending flight request. A scoped rule can prevent these replies from becoming no-ops or triggering questions about unrequested domains. Cache-saving and no-import requirements are already explicit in the skill, so repeating them would not patch a documentation gap.

edits.target: - Resolve brief affirmations such as “yes” against the immediately preceding assistant question or proposal, and carry forward the proposed entity or category as stated.
edits.content: - Treat a concrete answer to a domain-specific clarification as input for that pending request, even when the user does not repeat the domain. Apply the supplied criterion to the latest compatible cached result when one exists, or use the supplied required values to complete the pending search. If a travel-date clarification for an already-requested flight is answered with a start–end trip interval, use the start as the outbound departure date and the end as the return departure date on the reversed route, unless the user specifies one-way travel. Do not request hotel dates or initiate other domains unless lodging or those domains were requested.
